module ChuInoxGanDaArylic
  def self.build
    model = Sketchup.active_model
    model.start_operation('ChuInoxGanDaArylic', true)
    entities = model.active_entities

    # Tạo khung sắt đỡ
    frame_grp = entities.add_group
    frame_pts = [
      [0.mm, 0.mm, 0.mm],
      [1200.mm, 0.mm, 0.mm],
      [1200.mm, 60.mm, 0.mm],
      [0.mm, 60.mm, 0.mm]
    ]
    frame_face = frame_grp.entities.add_face(frame_pts)
    frame_face.pushpull(400.mm) # Cao 400mm
    frame_grp.material = "Gray"

    # Tạo bề mặt biển

    surface_pts = [
      [0.mm, 0.mm, 0.mm],
      [1200.mm, 0.mm, 0.mm],
      [1200.mm, 60.mm, 0.mm],
      [0.mm, 60.mm, 0.mm]

      [1200.mm, 10.mm, 60.mm],
